# Bloat & Bounds

A chaotic 2D platformer where you grow by eating and bound your way through increasingly absurd levels!

## How to Play
- Move left/right: Arrow keys or WASD
- Jump: W or Up arrow (double-jump available!)
- Eat edible items to grow bigger and score points
- Get larger = higher jumps, but bigger hitboxes!
- Avoid spikes, enemies, and breakable platforms
- Reach the end of each level!
